title: Baptist War (Christmas Rebellion in Jamaica)
note: Massive rebellion of roughly 60,000 enslaved workers led by Samuel Sharpe across western Jamaica; decisively accelerated British parliamentary passage of the 1833 Slavery Abolition Act.

title: Olaudah Equiano (Gustavus Vassa)
note: Igbo-born author, sailor, and Sons of Africa abolitionist whose 1789 autobiography exposed the horrors of the Middle Passage and energized British public opposition to chattel slavery.

title: Bussa's Rebellion (Barbados Slave Insurrection)
note: Major rebellion across Bridgetown and southern Barbados organized by enslaved ranger Bussa and Nanny Grigg, challenging imperial complacency following the 1807 slave trade ban.

title: Valongo Wharf, Rio de Janeiro
note: UNESCO-inscribed archaeological arrival site where an estimated 900,000 enslaved Africans were landed in Brazil; key tangible heritage of the transatlantic trade and resistance.
